text: When her father's boat drifts empty into New York Harbor carrying [a hidden zombie|threat|the dead that rise], Anne Bowles travels with the journalist Peter West to Matool, a Caribbean island where the dead are rising under [a voodoo curse|origin|curses laid by others]. Doctor David Menard has ordered his staff to [shoot every corpse in the head|rules|it has a fatal weakness], but the graves of a jungle clearing open and the island hospital is besieged. On the voyage home, the radio reports that [New York itself is under attack|ending|the evil spreads].
